observations: Black treadle sewing machine with gold decorative lettering on the head.
The brand name 'SINGER' is visible in gold lettering on the front of the machine head in photo 0.
The machine is mounted on a wooden table with a metal treadle base.
The machine appears to be in good cosmetic condition with no obvious rust or major damage.
A watermark 'MAY LENAPHEAL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The brand is Singer, which is American, but the origin of this specific unit cannot be confirmed from the photo.

claims.claim: the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may have a broken timing mechanism.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The treadle mechanism or the foot pedal may be broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the treadle being operated and the machine responding.

risks.risk: The bobbin case or needle may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin area and the needle.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate it works.
Photo of the bobbin area and the needle.
Video of the treadle being operated.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
